title: Janam Fidaye Haideri
body:
Dohai dega koi cheekh cheekh kar ek din
Khilafe deen nahi hai ali ali kehna
Vo apne maa ki shikayat karega mehshar me
Ke usne kyu na sikhaya ALI ALI KEHNA HAI
Jaanam Fida-e-Haideri Ya Ali Ali Ali
Hai Muhammad Mera Dil Toh Seena Ali
Mere Jeenay Ka Wahid Qareena Ali
Deen E Islam Ka Hai Nagina Ali
Haq Ki Manzil Ka Pehla Hai Zeena Ali
Dasht Mai Abr Ka Pehla Qatra Ali
Mera Murshid Bhi Aaqa Bhi Maula Ali
Ali...Maula Ali...Har Soo Sada E Haidery
Ya Ali Ali Ali
Subha Se Shaam Tak Har Peher Har Ghadi
Lab Pe Apnay Rahe Naara E Haidery
Yaani Khaiber Shikan Yaani Mushkil Kusha
Baade Yazdaan Ke Hai Doosra Aasra
Mai Musibat Mai Ab Kyu Parisha'n Rahun
Gham K Maaron Ka Hai Tu Sahara Ali
Ali...Maula Ali... Ramz E Baqaye Hashmi
Ya Ali Ali Ali
